RETT.title: White puts his queen on d8 with check, and the king has to take it. Why? #shorts
RETT.desc:
Reti vs Tartakower, Vienna 1910: 1.e4 c6 2.d4 d5 3.Nc3 dxe4 4.Nxe4 Nf6 5.Qd3 e5 6.dxe5 Qa5+ 7.Bd2 Qxe5 8.O-O-O Nxe4 9.Qd8+!! Kxd8 10.Bg5+ (double check from the bishop and the d1 rook) Kc7 11.Bd8#. The queen was bait: mate in three.

Would you have seen it?

TEED.title: White gives up his queen on move seven. Blunder or brilliant? #shorts
TEED.desc:
Teed vs Delmar, New York 1896: 1.d4 f5 2.Bg5 h6 3.Bf4 g5 4.Bg3 f4 5.e3 h5 6.Bd3 Rh6 7.Qxh5+! Rxh5 8.Bg6#. Only the h6 rook guarded g6. The queen dragged it away, and the bishop mated.

Blunder or brilliant?

LOYD.title: Black has a queen and two rooks and no legal move. How? #shorts
LOYD.desc:
Sam Loyd's ten-move stalemate: 1.e3 a5 2.Qh5 Ra6 3.Qxa5 h5 4.Qxc7 Rah6 5.h4 f6 6.Qxd7+ Kf7 7.Qxb7 Qd3 8.Qxb8 Qh7 9.Qxc8 Kg6 10.Qe6. Every black piece is stuck and Black is not in check: stalemate, a draw in ten moves.

Did you know this one?

#chess #stalemate #chesspuzzle

LOYD.ig:
Black still has his queen and both rooks, and he cannot make a single move. How? Did you know this one?

LASK.title: Black's pawn is about to promote. Should it become a queen? #shorts
LASK.desc:
The Lasker trap in the Albin Countergambit: 1.d4 d5 2.c4 e5 3.dxe5 d4 4.e3 Bb4+ 5.Bd2 dxe3 6.Bxb4? exf2+ 7.Ke2 fxg1=N+! 7...fxg1=Q? 8.Qxd8+ Kxd8 9.Rxg1 wins it back. The knight comes with check: 8.Ke1 Qh4+ (or 8.Rxg1 Bg4+ and the queen falls) and Black wins.

Would you have made a queen?

#chess #chesstraps #underpromotion

SHRV.title: Black gives his only bishop away for nothing. Is he crazy? #shorts
SHRV.desc:

DING.title: This one move cost the world champion his title. What did he miss? #shorts
DING.desc:
Ding Liren vs Gukesh, World Championship 2024, game 14: in a dead draw Ding played 55.Rf2?? Rxf2 56.Kxf2 Bd5! 57.Bxd5 Kxd5 58.Ke3 Ke5, and Ding resigned. His bishop on a8 had nowhere to go, so the trade was forced and the pawn ending was lost. Gukesh became the youngest undisputed world champion at 18.

Did you see Bd5 coming?

#chess #gukesh #worldchampionship

SPFI.title: Fischer takes a pawn on h2 with his bishop. Can the bishop get out? #shorts
SPFI.desc:

Did you see Qf2?
